The "Definitional" topic in this corpus outlines the specific clinical criteria used to evaluate healthcare quality metrics and performance indicators. In the context of the 2023 AFDK reporting, it establishes the exact conditions required to satisfy [[indikator-1|Indikator 1]]. This indicator is designed to measure the timeliness of medical interventions for patients requiring blood thinners. 

Specifically, the definitional criterion dictates that a patient fulfills the requirements of the indicator if their waiting time from the initial diagnosis to the commencement of [[antikoagulationsbehandling|antikoagulationsbehandling]] is a maximum of 30 days [^src1]. This 30-day threshold serves as a critical benchmark for assessing whether clinical departments are initiating necessary preventive treatments promptly, which is essential for reducing the risk of adverse cardiovascular events such as strokes. 

Because the available evidence for this specific topic is limited to this single definitional parameter, no further chronological, relational, or broader contextual details are present in the current data extract.

## Claims
- Patienter med en ventetid på max. 30 dage fra diagnosticering til opstart i antikoagulationsbehandling opfylder indikatoren [^src1] (indikator-1, antikoagulationsbehandling)
